name: votechain
description: Local blockchain-based voting mini project for educational use

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n CHAIN,DEPLOY,SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,green,magenta,cyan "npm run chain" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:8545 && npm run deploy" "wait-on file:build/contracts.json && npm run server" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3001/api/health && npm run client"
